verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's built-in agent Ari answers questions about your data, such as whether you can afford to hire, why spending went up, or how long your cash lasts. It also runs one-line scenarios, drafts board decks from last night's numbers, and proactively messages you when something moves. All of this happens inside the product, on data from your connected ledger, bank and payroll systems. missing for 10: explicit documentation of actionable recommendations beyond answers and alerts, in-depth docs on how insights are generated and surfaced (evidence is mostly one-line vendor claims), independent or hands-on corroboration.
